name: Neuhausen/Spree (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Neuhausen/Spree (quartered with a swallow, wavy bars and a stork).
history: Municipal flag of Neuhausen/Spree; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Neuhausen/Spree arms — quartered with swallow, wavy bars and stork
